title: Puck'd Up
tagline: Read the rebound. Own the table. First to seven.
description: Fast 3D air hockey with 12 named rivals, a 12-stop Arcade Circuit across eight venues, custom paddle colors, and pointer, touch or keyboard controls. Play casual online 1v1 through Player Factory quick search or private rooms, with server-controlled physics and scoring.
status: Playable - vs CPU and casual online 1v1
